summary: Unicorn and breaker model setups after sweeps, with HTF candles, multi-timeframe liquidity, session levels, FVGs, SMT and stats tables.
overview: This community script looks for the ICT Unicorn model: a breaker block that overlaps a fair value gap after liquidity is taken. It can show only Unicorn setups or breakers too, with potential setups drawn before confirmation and invalidated ones in a ghost color.

Around the setups it draws higher-timeframe candles with optional open, high, low and close lines, liquidity from up to three timeframes (60, 240 and D by default), session liquidity for up to four sessions, sweep lines, standalone higher-timeframe FVGs, SMT lines, target projections, and info and stats tables with a timer.
how: Liquidity sources use OHLC levels plus swing points from each source timeframe, mapped automatically or set by you. A setup forms when price sweeps a level, breaks structure, and leaves a breaker overlapping an FVG.

The stop sits at the manipulation extreme, and targets are drawn at the R multiples you list. Optional parts include a break-even move at 50%, a daily cap on how many setups can reach target or stop, a breaker size filter and a time filter. SMT uses a pair mapped automatically or set manually.
use: Use it to see where a breaker and an FVG overlap after a sweep.
Some traders keep the higher-timeframe candles on screen to stay aware of the bigger candle.
Use the liquidity lines to see which levels have been swept.
Use the stats table to review past setups under the script's rules.
alerts: Alerts: the script sends its own alert messages, and members can create an alert on them from the chart's alert dialog; alerts from indicators run while ZoroCharts is open in the browser.
notes: Up to 50 setups are kept in history by default.
Targets, stops and limits follow the script's own rules.
SMT and multi-timeframe liquidity need extra data requests.
